Integral adjacency spectrum proves 2pi periodicity and arbitrary late times; independently computed six-by-six matrix exponentials agree numerically. No finite experiment is used as a substitute for a general proof.

value.rationale: The exact minimum cardinality of a randomized observation-time protocol delivering a uniform endpoint distribution on a fixed natural graph is a motivated intrinsic optimization problem. The C6 result supplies a complete optimality proof with explicit positive probabilities and phases for a case whose conventional cycle Cesàro mixing is not uniform. It is not a routine reparameterization of a published uniform cycle protocol or just a numerical witness; its content includes a sharp physical support complexity threshold. The claim is deliberately local rather than overstated as an infinite-family theorem.
